catalog.summary: Highlighted source code with copy and line limits.

patternAbsent.reason: The WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices index holds no code pattern, and no ARIA role describes a block of source. Code is text and is read as text; Carbon's role=textbox with aria-readonly on a block nobody can edit is a role that lies, and it is refused

governedBy.effect: A block wider than its box has to be scrollable by keyboard, which scroll-area supplies
The rule the criterion is tested by; the tab stop it asks for owes a name, and the name is the title, then aria-label, then messages.region
Code is the named exception to one-dimensional reflow, and the wrap control answers it anyway
The language is written as class=language-<x> on the code element, the specification's own convention and what every engine keys on

input.code: a string; the family draws plainLines(code) synchronously and never receives HTML
input.tokens: CodeLine[] from @slotted/core/code — text in spans with a data-token scope, so an engine's output is never written with innerHTML
input.highlight: (code, language) => CodeLine[] | Promise<CodeLine[]>; resolved in an effect and swapped line by line into the grid the text already laid out, so nothing moves
input.adapters: fromPrismTokens and fromShikiTokens in @slotted/core/code map the two engines' token shapes onto twelve scopes and import neither engine
input.failure: a rejected highlighter leaves the plain text and reports through onHighlightError

palette.tokens: --slotted-code-<scope>, twelve, component layer, scheme axis, root, forced colour CanvasText
palette.ground: --slotted-surface-sunken, the fence's ground prose already draws
palette.ratio: 4.5:1 in light and dark, 7:1 in high-contrast, measured by packages/themes/test/default-theme.test.mjs
palette.reason: the five tones give five hues and a language has more than five kinds of word; painting a keyword with danger would make one tone mean two things on a page that also has an error — the bar upload's file-kind scale cleared

composes.body: scroll-area, worn as data-ui: the region role, the tab stop and the name exist only while the code overflows; no scroll measure of this family's own
composes.copy: description-list's control: @slotted/core/clipboard, data-complete for two seconds, the check glyph in place of the two sheets, the outcome announced politely
composes.loading: skeleton lines inside the frame at the height collapseAfter, or six lines, would give
composes.icon: fileKind from @slotted/core/upload picks the file-kind glyph beside a filename

marks.shape: { highlight?, add?, remove?, focus?, error?, warning? }, each '1,4-6' or number[], parsed once by parseLineRanges
marks.focus: separate: dims every line outside its range with data-dim, lifted on hover and focus-within, dropped under forced colours
marks.magicComments: not parsed; a Markdown pipeline that has them hands the family marks

copy.text: copyText(code, marks, { includeRemoved }): the code the consumer gave, never the DOM's text; a gutter, a marker or a wrapped line changes nothing on the clipboard
copy.removed: remove lines are dropped unless copyRemoved, because the code after the change is what a reader pastes

wrap.value: pre-wrap on the pre under data-wrap; overflow-wrap anywhere so an unbroken token breaks rather than escapes
wrap.control: aria-pressed, drawn only while some line overflows, read from scroll-area's inline edge state
wrap.continuation: a wrapped continuation is indented to the line's own leading whitespace, measured once per line in ch

collapse.axis: collapseAfter, in lines, unset by default
collapse.revealed: the word description-list put in the vocabulary for a clamped value shown whole; the hidden lines stay in the DOM and in a selection
collapse.escape: Escape with focus inside the revealed block collapses it and keeps focus
collapse.maxLines: the other bound: the body scrolls past it and never collapses; the two compose

direction: ltr on the pre whatever the page's direction, prose's rule; the header keeps the page's
density: the inset and the gutter follow the density scale; the type does not, because code at dense is still read one character at a time

keyboard.effect: the copy control, the wrap control, the reveal control, then the body when it overflows

keyboard.key: ArrowUp / ArrowDown / ArrowLeft / ArrowRight / PageUp / PageDown / Home / End / Space
keyboard.effect: in the body: the platform's scroll
on copy, wrap or reveal: the button
with focus inside a revealed block: collapses it, reason escape

declined.tabs: tabs owns a row of panels: <Tabs><Tabs.Panel><CodeBlock/></Tabs.Panel></Tabs>
declined.inline: a span in running text is typography — prose draws code in a sentence, kbd draws a key, description-list's copy is a copyable inline value
declined.terminalFrame: one implementation; data-language=sh is in the DOM for a consumer's stylesheet
declined.disabled: a block of text has no action to disable; the copy control is a button and takes disabled as any button does
declined.virtualization: a block that is not all in the DOM is not copyable by selection; maxLines bounds what is painted through the scrollport
declined.engine: no grammar is written or bundled; the highlight engine is an optional package the consumer loads, docs/component-features.md §10

dataAttributes.data-empty: on the root when code is empty
dataAttributes.data-overflow: on the root while a line overflows the box, which is when the wrap control is drawn
dataAttributes.data-mark: on a line, one of highlight, add, remove, error, warning
dataAttributes.data-dim: on a line outside the focus range

literals.gutter digits: the counter's width is calc(<digits>ch + inset), digits from the line count; ch is a measure of the mono face, not a scale
